mermaid:
flowchart LR
    SF["Storefronts and channels"] --> R["Router or copy of the flow"]
    R -->|"everything else"| OLD["Old owner"]
    R -->|"one seam at a time"| NEW["New owner"]
    OLD --> REC["Reconciliation job"]
    NEW --> REC
    REC -->|"agree"| NEXT["Route the next seam"]
    REC -->|"disagree"| BACK["Route back and fix"]

sequenceDiagram
    participant PL as the platform
    participant IP as the iPaaS
    participant OMS as the OMS
    participant WMS as the WMS
    participant REC as reconciliation
    PL->>IP: Marketplace order created
    IP->>OMS: Copy of the order, shadow phase
    IP->>WMS: Order to pick, old path
    REC->>OMS: Compare orders of the day
    REC->>WMS: Compare orders of the day
    REC-->>IP: Zero differences for 14 days, go
    PL->>IP: Marketplace order created
    IP->>OMS: Order, now the owner
    OMS->>WMS: Order to pick, new path
    REC-->>IP: Differences found, route the seam back
